items.title: Rupee gains 30 paise to touch monthly high
items.description: The Indian rupee closed at 95.38 on Friday, strengthening significantly. Persistent Reserve Bank of India interventions and lower oil prices aided this currency gain. The local unit traded within a narrow range during the trading session. A weaker dollar index also contributed to the rupee's upward movement. Analysts expect continued support for the rupee at lower levels.

items.title: IRDAI tightens ownership norms, eases capital infusion
items.description: IRDAI has tightened oversight on insurer ownership changes and eased capital raising. Investors now need prior approval for shareholding changes exceeding five percent. The regulator also extended approval requirements to promoter group transfers. Dilution from existing shareholders not participating is now a transfer event. These amendments were announced late Friday by the authority.

items.title: Sebi bans Zee's Subhash Chandra, Punit Goenka from markets for a year
items.description: Sebi has barred Zee founder Subhash Chandra and CEO Punit Goenka from the securities market for one year. This action stems from an unauthorized pledge of company land to secure promoter group loans. The regulator also imposed a significant penalty on Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited. Shareholders approved a convertible warrant issuance, raising promoters' stake substantially. This development follows a previous investor rejection of a similar proposal.

items.title: IDBI's unlisted share sales not a public issue: Sebi
items.description: Sebi has clarified that IDBI Bank can sell unlisted shares privately. These transactions will not be considered public issues by the regulator. This clarification allows for privately negotiated deals with identified buyers. IDBI Bank sought this guidance for its holdings in unlisted companies. The move facilitates secondary transfers of equity shares under specific conditions.

items.title: Strong earnings, FPI inflows keep Indian equities resilient despite global risks
items.description: Indian equity indices wrapped up July on a high note, achieving their best monthly performance in three months with significant gains. The robust corporate earnings played a critical role in alleviating fears related to rising oil prices. The Nifty and Sensex jumped over 2.5% in the week and nearly 2.1% throughout July.

items.title: Sebi disposes of case against Religare Enterprises, Saluja, other persons
items.description: Sebi has concluded legal actions against Religare Enterprises and its former chairperson.  The regulator found no further directions were needed after the open offer.  Proceedings were initiated alleging Religare failed to cooperate with the mandatory open offer.  The company had questioned the Burman Group's 'fit and proper' status and delayed approvals.  The open offer's completion achieved the remedial objective of Sebi's proceedings.

items.title: Deposit rates rise as banks fight for funds
items.description: Banks increased fresh term deposit rates in June, led by private lenders.  The average domestic term deposit rate rose to 5.99% for scheduled commercial banks.  Private banks saw a significant 27 basis point increase in their deposit rates.  Public sector banks also raised rates by 7 basis points.  Their average deposit rate remained higher than private sector offerings.

items.title: Stock picks of the week: 6 stocks with consistent score improvement and upside potential of up to 29%
items.description: To understand where the markets may go from here, three questions need to be answered. First, when will the war end? Second, how long will it take to rebuild infrastructure? Third, what will the geopolitical situation look like after? Nobody knows the answers to any of these questions. So, accept that markets are likely to remain uncertain for some time. But they need not be clearly bearish. Our selected stocks for today depict a strong upward trajectory in their overall average score which is based on five key pillars: Earnings, fundamentals, relative valuation, risk, and price momentum. This implies that there has been a significant improvement in their market outlook in the given time frame.

items.title: Bank credit to industry up 19%, personal loans stay strong
items.description: Banking credit to industry saw a robust 19% year-on-year increase. Personal loan growth also remained strong, expanding 16% compared to last year. Loans against gold jewellery surged by 93%, leading personal loan segment growth. Vehicle loans followed with a 17% expansion, while credit card growth decelerated. Education loans maintained strong growth at 13% year-on-year.

items.title: PNB raising $1 billion for FCNR on-lending
items.description: Punjab National Bank is set to secure a substantial one billion dollars through a five-year loan arrangement. This initiative is being coordinated with international financiers to enhance participation. The loan will be eligible for the Reserve Bank of India's special swap facility. Indian banks are eager to tap into dollar funds to capitalize on overseas client deposits, targeting potential leveraged investors in the forex-deposit program.
